text:
maria: quick sync  i'm bundling a tiny docs push for tomorrow: fallback routing snippet, a known streaming-embeddings truncation issue, and a couple of small SDK example fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4278

sam: can we make the whatsnew bullets strictly factual? a short 2-3 line bulleted list is ideal.

maria: yes  bullets only, with links to migration steps. avoid marketing adjectives.

oliver: i've fixed the node SDK example where we were passing `fallbacks` as an object instead of an array. committed to PR.

meenakshi: added a one-line Python fallback example sized for the whatsnew box. posted in the PR.

maria: sample Python snippet looks fine. please add a parenthetical: (quantized fallback may use a different tokenizer; check prompt/stop tokens).

oliver: noted. i also added a tiny doc comment in examples about verifying stop sequences with quantized models.

meenakshi: found a broken link: /docs/dedicated/autoscale -> 404. opened PR #4279 to add a redirect to /docs/dedicated/scaling.

maria: i'll list that under Known issues as "redirect in progress" so readers see we're on it.

docs-bot: reminder: staging deploy scheduled for 09:00 UTC tomorrow after signoff.

sam: i'll run a local build and smoke-test examples after the final edits.

maria: timeline  final edits tonight, request LGTM by 07:30 UTC, stage at 09:00 UTC.

oliver: LGTM  node example renders and lint passes.

meenakshi: LGTM  python snippet renders. left a tiny wording suggestion on the PR.

maria: thanks all  i'll squash & merge after adding the tokenizer parenthetical and the redirect note. i'll post when staging is live. :rocket:
